name: PayBito Pay for WooCommerce
author: PayBito Pay

sections.description:
PayBito Pay for WooCommerce allows WooCommerce stores to accept cryptocurrency payments securely through the PayBito payment infrastructure.

Features

  • Accept BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, LTC, XRP, BCH, BNB, DOGE, and SOL
  • Automatic WooCommerce order status updates using secure webhooks
  • Setup Wizard for quick onboarding
  • Transaction log dashboard
  • Configurable order statuses
  • WooCommerce-compatible debug logging
  • Manual refund support through the merchant dashboard

External services

This plugin connects to external PayBito APIs to process cryptocurrency payments and manage merchant payment configurations.

It sends the following data when a customer places an order or when the merchant configures payment settings:

  • Order amount
  • Currency
  • Order details
  • Customer checkout information
  • Merchant API credentials
  • Payment configuration data

Service provider: PayBito / HashCash Consultants

API endpoints used:
* https://api.paybito.com/
* https://service.hashcashconsultants.com/

Terms of Service:
https://www.paybito.com/terms-of-service/

Privacy Policy:
https://www.paybito.com/privacy-policy/

API Documentation:
https://paybito.com/payments/api-doc/

Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open PayBito Pay → Setup Wizard.
  3. Enter your PayBito API credentials.
  4. Configure the webhook URL in your PayBito dashboard.
  5. Enable the cryptocurrencies you want to accept.
  6. Customers can now pay using cryptocurrency.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the paybito-pay-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Go to PayBito Pay → Setup Wizard and complete the setup.
  4. Alternatively, configure it from WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → PayBito Pay.
sections.faq:
Do I need a PayBito account?

Yes. You need a PayBito merchant account to obtain API credentials.

Where can I find the webhook secret?

You can find it in your PayBito merchant dashboard under the webhook settings section.

Are refunds supported?

Refunds must be processed manually from the PayBito merchant dashboard.

What webhook URL should I use?

The plugin automatically generates the webhook URL inside the setup wizard and gateway settings page.
